name: GDEX
recent: GDEX 近期持续进行股份回购，自 2026 年 10 月至 11 月多次在公开市场买回股票。2026 年 8 月底，董事经理兼集团首席执行官 Teong Teck Lean 增持 2000 万股，同时大股东 Yamato Holdings 的持股变动也被披露。公司已于 2026 年 8 月 21 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的业绩报告。
notable: 董事经理兼集团首席执行官 Teong Teck Lean 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日以每股 RM0.10 增持 2000 万股普通股（直接权益）。
公司于 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次进行股份回购。
大股东 Yamato Holdings Co., Ltd. 的持股变动于 2026 年 8 月 28 日披露。
risks: 董事经理兼集团首席执行官 Teong Teck Lean 在 2026 年 8 月 26 日增持 2000 万股，导致其持股比例发生变化。
大股东 Yamato Holdings Co., Ltd. 的持股出现变动，需关注其后续动向。

recent_en: GDEX has been continuously conducting share buybacks, repurchasing shares in the open market multiple times from October to November 2026. In late August 2026, Managing Director/Group CEO Teong Teck Lean acquired 20 million shares, while changes in substantial shareholder Yamato Holdings' interest were also disclosed. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 21 August 2026.
notable_en: Managing Director/Group CEO Teong Teck Lean acquired 20 million ordinary shares (direct interest) at RM0.10 per share on 26 August 2026.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks between October and November 2026.
Changes in the interest of substantial shareholder Yamato Holdings Co., Ltd. were disclosed on 28 August 2026.
risks_en: Managing Director/Group CEO Teong Teck Lean acquired 20 million shares on 26 August 2026, resulting in a change in his shareholding percentage.
Substantial shareholder Yamato Holdings Co., Ltd. has changed its shareholding; further developments warrant attention.
